item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.81)] MSFT Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Microsoft Corporation Securities Fraud Lawsuit
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.81)
The Rosen Law Firm announces a class action lawsuit for purchasers of Microsoft (MSFT) common stock between May 1, 2025, and January 28, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Microsoft made false and misleading statements regarding problems with its Copilot products, its AI model ranking below competitors, and the need for significant capital expenditure increases. Investors who purchased during this period have until August 11, 2026, to move the Court to serve as lead plaintiff.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14)] Ireland gains 17.1bn dollars in Apple tax after state aid escrow release
item.description:
